name: @tr-file/desktop
description: Electron shell running the whole tr-file stack in one process
author: Ivan Maglica <licence@tronog.com>
//desktopName: Read by electron-builder: the .desktop entry it writes, and the WM_CLASS the window reports, have to agree or the taskbar cannot match one to the other.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && rm -rf dist && node scripts/bundle.mjs
scripts.dev: pnpm build && TR_FILE_DEV=1 TR_FILE_DEVTOOLS=1 TR_FILE_DEV_SERVER=http://localhost:4200 electron .

//devDependencies: Nothing here is a runtime dependency of the distributable: scripts/bundle.mjs compiles the backend and its Express/Busboy into dist/main.cjs, so the packaged app loads no node_modules at all (PRD 001, §8.3).
